sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
Western Local Land Services (Western LLS) is seeking submissions from suitably qualified and licensed Professional Kangaroo Harvesters for appointment to a panel to support the delivery of a targeted kangaroo management program across Western New South Wales. The program aims to assist landholders in areas experiencing significant grazing pressure and animal welfare impacts associated with overabundant kangaroo populations.
The panel will be used to engage contractors to travel to priority locations identified by Western LLS to facilitate commercial kangaroo harvesting in remote areas and undertake approved non-commercial culling activities where required. Commercial harvesting remains a business-as-usual activity undertaken under existing regulatory arrangements, with program support focused on improving access to remote locations and increasing the availability of professional kangaroo management services.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
Panel members may be engaged to travel to priority locations identified by Western LLS to facilitate commercial kangaroo harvesting in remote areas and undertake approved non-commercial culling activities where required. All harvesting and culling activities must be undertaken with the explicit consent of the participating landholder and in accordance with applicable licences, harvest quotas and regulatory requirements.
Services may include project induction and planning, travel to nominated properties, delivery of harvesting and/or culling activities, data collection, reporting and invoicing in accordance with Work Order requirements.
Tenderers must hold and maintain the required licences, accreditations, insurances, training certificates, competencies and equipment necessary to undertake services safely and in compliance with the National Code of Practice for the Humane Shooting of Kangaroos and Wallabies for Commercial Purposes, and as required by LLS.
